generationPromptZh: 一个带空腔、封底及贯通角形把手的方形马克杯。它由杯底、杯壁、口沿和侧面上下接壁的把手组成。底部厚度约为主体宽度的0.17倍，连续壁围成开口空腔。宽深比约1.82，高/最大水平跨度约0.55；口沿位于围合侧壁上方，口沿与主体宽度比1.00。实测采用2种不透明颜色，杯壁以棕色为主，把手呈浅棕色。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.55, "category": "mug", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "depth": 12.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "height": 14.0, "instance": 0, "lipOverhang": 0.6, "neckFraction": 0.42, "ordinal": 64761, "redesign": 0, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.58, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 14.0}
generationPromptEn: An angular mug with a hollow body, closed floor and pierced handle. It includes a floor, walls, rim and a side handle attached at upper and lower roots. The floor is 0.17 body-widths thick; connected walls surround an open cavity. Width/depth is 1.82; height/horizontal-span is 0.55. The rim sits above the surrounding walls. Rim/body width is 1.00. Across 2 opaque colors, the walls is mainly brown and the handle is tan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
